gaps.gap: The corpus is a mechanism sample, not a complete beneficiary-level census.
Programmatic alignment does not establish instruction over each downstream publication or moderation decision.
Not every contractual term or beneficiary subgrant is public.
These objectives do not by themselves prove censorship of lawful political speech.
Formal controls do not prove perfect neutrality or effectiveness.

The chain is well evidenced through program design, selection and funded capacity/outputs, but not as a general chain to specific lawful-content removal, persuasion or electoral outcome.
